entries.change: Recipe reworked: a worker now cooks 2 StrogMix over one fire into two bowls at once, and the pot splits into 2 Stroganoff by itself. 1 Meat + 1 Mushroom makes 4 Stroganoff (was 8) and the fire costs 0.4 Stick per 4 bowls. Construction work 105 → 90 builder actions; a fire lasts 0.12 days (was 0.1). Cost unchanged.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: The dried-pot pile holds 1 pot (was 12) and shaping a wet pot from Clay takes 9.6 s (was 9.1). Villagers now drink it (a drinking animation, where it used to be eaten), and the building now shows its recipe as 1 Stick + 1 Mushroom + 3 Clay → 3 Concoction. Recipe and cost unchanged.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Added to every sandbox biome’s base list. Construction is now 4 spots of 15 actions instead of 6 of 10: the same 60 actions, but a full crew needs 30 actions’ time instead of 20. Its entrance moved to the other side, and villagers can walk across 7 of its tiles (was 5). Storage unchanged.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Added to every sandbox biome’s base list. Walking speed unchanged: ×2.15, the same as the Stone Road.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Coypu burrows can now appear on soil as well as sand, and on slightly sloped ground (height difference up to 0.1).

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Its coypu burrows can now sit on soil as well as sand, and on slightly sloped ground. Description now says the tree is endemic to the Wetlands (was Swamplands).

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Lost a second, inactive mushroom spawner; the remaining one makes the Willow the only Mushroom source in the game files. The Willow and Cypress fields became plantable.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: The inactive mushroom spawners on 12 trees and the unused forage source were deleted; only Willow Trees drop Mushrooms. The description now says they are found around Willow Trees, and that eating them raw can have side-effects.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) game files compared with version 31 (build 255); research data/release-32-257 and docs/RELEASE-32-257.md.

entries.change: Changed at release: the Brick Road goal is 60 tiles (was 80), a new optional goal asks for 10 Calla Lilly Planters, and Warehouses and Calla Lilly Planters can be built. The map no longer starts with 27 tiles of Brick Road or a finished Roadworks Office (it starts as a build site), and the wooden hoes are gone. Oona now leads the level.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) level file compared with version 31 (255); research tools/refresh_level_records.py.

entries.change: Changed at release: the level starts with 6 adults (was 4) and the optional population goal is 16 (was 20). Oona now leads the level.

evidence.reference: Version 32 (build 257) level file compared with version 31 (255); research tools/refresh_level_records.py.

entries.change: Changed at release: the population goal of 16 became an optional goal of 20, the optional Calla Lilly Planter goal became one for 16 pairs of Boots, Warehouses can be built and Calla Lilly Planters can't. The map starts with Wetlands villagers, a stockpile of Dried Meat, Barley Porridge and Stew, and no Book Workshop, Brick Road or expedition crates; there is one Ruin fewer. Oona now leads the level.
